title: How do I join?
text: How do I join? Contact the age group coordinator for a trial session. New players may attend two sessions before registering, free of charge.

title: Which age group is my child in?
text: Which age group is my child in? Age group is set by the player's age on 31 August of the season year, not by school year.

title: Can I pay in instalments?
text: Can I pay in instalments? Yes. Subscriptions may be paid in full, or across four monthly instalments beginning in September. Contact the treasurer to set this up.

title: Can I get a refund?
text: Can I get a refund? Subscriptions are non-refundable after the fourth week of the season, except for a season-ending injury.

title: What should my child bring?
text: What should my child bring? Shin pads, boots appropriate to the surface, and a filled water bottle. Jewellery, including earrings and fitness trackers, must be removed before play.

title: Can I volunteer?
text: Can I volunteer? Yes. The club needs assistant coaches, match-day helpers and committee members. All roles working directly with players require a background check, which the club arranges and pays for.

title: Where do away fixtures take place?
text: Where do away fixtures take place? Venues vary by league. The fixtures secretary circulates the address, kickoff time, and parking notes on the club channel by the Thursday before.

title: Floodlit training slots for winter
text: Floodlit training slots for winter Floodlit pitch slots are limited between November and February. The committee has agreed to rotate the existing allocation between the under-13 and under-15 groups rather than fixing it to one group for the season. Coaches will be notified of their allocation by 15 October.

title: Photo consent reminder
text: Photo consent reminder No photograph or video of a player may be published on any club channel without a photo consent record on file. Consent is recorded at registration and may be withdrawn at any time by written notice to the club secretary, taking effect within five working days.

title: Head injury protocol update
text: Head injury protocol update Any player who sustains a head impact is removed from play immediately and may not return the same day. Return to play requires written clearance. All coaches must record the incident in the session log within 24 hours.

title: Registration and Eligibility
text: Players must register before the first scheduled training session of the season. Registration requires a completed player form, proof of date of birth, and payment of the season subscription or an approved payment plan. A player is not eligible to appear in a competitive fixture until registration is complete and recorded in the club system. Age groups are determined by the player's age on 31 August of the current season year. A player may play up an age group with written approval from both coaches and the age group coordinator; playing down is not permitted under any circumstances.

title: Subscriptions
text: The season subscription covers coaching, pitch hire, league entry, referee fees and one training kit. Families registering more than one player receive a reduction on each additional player's subscription. Hardship arrangements are handled confidentially by the club treasurer; no player is excluded from participation for reasons of cost. Fees shown are for the 2026–27 season and are reviewed each April.

title: U7 – U9 season fee
text: U7 – U9: season fee £120, or 4 instalments of £30. Kit included: Yes.

title: U10 – U12 season fee
text: U10 – U12: season fee £150, or 4 instalments of £37.50. Kit included: Yes.

title: U13 – U15 season fee
text: U13 – U15: season fee £180, or 4 instalments of £45. Kit included: Yes.

title: U16 – U18 season fee
text: U16 – U18: season fee £195, or 4 instalments of £48.75. Kit included: Training top only.

title: Kit and Equipment
text: Every registered player receives one training kit at the start of the season. Match kit is issued to the squad by the coach and returned at the end of the season, laundered. Shin pads are mandatory for all training sessions and fixtures without exception; a player without shin pads will not be permitted onto the pitch. Boots must be appropriate to the surface. Jewellery of any kind, including earrings and fitness trackers, must be removed before play.

title: Code of Conduct
text: Players, coaches, and spectators are expected to treat match officials with respect at all times. Dissent toward an official is a disciplinary matter for the club regardless of any action taken by the league. Coaches are responsible for the conduct of their spectators. A first incident results in a written warning; a second results in a touchline ban for a period determined by the committee. The club operates a no-tolerance position on discriminatory language, with immediate suspension pending investigation. title: Away Travel
text: For away fixtures, players under 13 must be accompanied by a parent, guardian, or a nominated responsible adult recorded with the club in advance. Coaches may not transport a player alone in a vehicle. Where the club arranges shared transport, a register is taken at departure and on return. Squads travelling more than 90 minutes require a second adult accompanying the coach.

title: Adverse Weather
text: A decision on cancellation is made by the age group coordinator no later than two hours before the scheduled kickoff and communicated through the club messaging channel. Play is suspended immediately on the sighting of lightning and may not resume for at least 30 minutes after the last strike. Pitches are inspected for frost before any session in December, January and February.

title: Injury and Return to Play
text: Any player who sustains a head impact is removed from play immediately and may not return the same day. Return to play after a head injury requires written clearance. All injuries occurring at a club session are recorded in the incident log within 24 hours by the session coach. At least one first-aid-qualified adult must be present at every training session and fixture.
